competitive_pointer.snapshot_custody: external target only; no local archive authority implied
competitive_pointer.success_rule: a custody-complete score below the refreshed pointer is a frontier milestone

mission.success_rule: continue after the first frontier break until an authoritative exact archive is below 0.15

objective.proposal_rule: smooth costates and proxies may rank proposals
objective.admission_rule: accept an atomic same-object bundle only after exact serialization, decode, and joint nonlinear delta-S measurement; individual micro-prefixes need not each be downhill

allowed_inputs: frozen upstream evaluator code, weights, runtime, and source video
source-derived caches built by this project
this project's original measurements, equations, code, state, and bitstreams
mechanism lessons and falsifiers abstracted from public PRs
forbidden_candidate_lineage: public PR code, weights, checkpoints, latents, clicks, selectors, tokens, or sidecars
public score deltas transplanted across archive identities
originality_boundary.public_frontier_role: external target and mechanism/falsifier prior only

codec_thesis.encoder: offline compiler specialized to the frozen evaluator information space
codec_thesis.bitstream: candidate sufficient statistic minimized under the exact coupled objective; global minimality is unproven
codec_thesis.decoder: deterministic portable generator with no scorer weights and no ground-truth table
codec_thesis.identity_rule: every edge binds exact parent and child content hashes; archive sections and receipts are compiler outputs, never substitutes for scientific state

two_plane_evaluator_model.spatial_operator: the same frozen torch-f32 bilinear resize maps each camera frame to 384x512
two_plane_evaluator_model.posenet_obligation: PoseNet consumes the coupled YUV6 transform of both Y0 and Y1
two_plane_evaluator_model.non_decomposition_rule: Y0 and Y1 are temporally distinct but jointly optimized; independent Seg and Pose target images are invalid

v9_predictive_syntax: per-class heterogeneous carriers rather than one class-naive field
level sets, Morse-Smale cells, topology births/deaths/splits/merges
worldsheet and xi transport with sparse events
Road/Undrivable bulk boundary, Lane chart/phase, Movable islands, and MyCar closure
merge-diff-correct reconciliation and receiver-visible AA-SDF rasterization
finite topology and chart grammar priced from the first complete candidate

discrete_geometry: camera-to-Y0/Y1 realization under the actual contest geometry
palette, gauge, and nullspace reconciliation before any terminal residual
conditional frame0 and xi solve after the realized last frame is fixed
r10_prosody_and_feature_relay: amplitude, frequency, phase, contrast, channel-energy, and texture controls
PoseNet feature-relay or multiple-shooting constraints through frozen nonlinear blocks
explicit handling of batch-norm, squeeze/excitation, and other nonlocal feature couplings
amplitude-structured xi-advected photometry for Pose rather than a low-rank additive frame0 patch
v10_realization_compiler.factor10_role: joint Seg/Pose/rate closure, ordered commutators, real coder effects, and atomic bundle admission
v10_realization_compiler.legacy_receiver_warning: the current V10 structural receiver is launch_ready=false and its placeholder XOR/digest/cyclic handlers are not production physics

logical_stream_roles.content: cell identities, topology events, and transport lineage
joint Road/Undrivable bulk and boundary chart
Lane center, width, dash phase, and sparse events
Movable island events and MyCar closure
Y1 winner/margin obligations plus Y0/Y1 uint8 preimage and palette/gauge state
xi, frame0, prosody, and frozen-feature-relay Pose controls
only debt unreachable by the declared analytic and inverse routes

physical_coding_rule: logical roles have distinct provenance and mutation ownership, but may share a joint physical entropy section when exact joint coding wins
scientific_stream_custody_rule: a populated stream is trusted only when a verified loader derives its content and provenance addresses from the exact payload snapshots and emits a parent-state-bound construction receipt; a deserialized or caller-attested ContentAddress alone is not source custody

aa_sdf_n600.scope: renderer primitive, not a full witness

v9_n256_error_mass.source_scope: measured historical V9 carrier bridge; not a candidate parent
v9_n256_error_mass.interpretation: Road plus Movable contribute about 87 percent of current error mass; Lane and Movable have the worst conditional failure rates

acceptance_suite.role: reuse the exact source-derived obligations as interface tests, not the historical archive or actuator
acceptance_suite.price_status: unpriced until the original receiver and real coder materialize each row

first_decision_quality_artifact.name: coarse_complete_n600_two_plane_vertical_slice
requirements: all 600 pairs and all five semantic classes are internal to the same source-derived state
explicit Y0 and Y1 obligations and contest-native 874x1164 uint8 realization
finite grammar and real coder charged from the first archive
deterministic archive, inflate entrypoint, decoded-output hashes, and parse-back receipt
same-object d_seg, d_pose, archive bytes, and exact coupled score on a clearly labelled local axis
per-class and per-pair debt plus 25-row interface acceptance readout
first_decision_quality_artifact.quality_policy: it may be poor but must be complete; its measured debt chooses the next refinement
first_decision_quality_artifact.subset_policy: n24 or smaller fixtures are parser, unit, and mutation tests only and cannot choose a scientific branch or support a score verdict

build_dag.name: metadata identity scaffold

build_dag.gate: source/evaluator/receiver bytes are content-addressed and JSON roundtrips are exact; no archive, decode, or score is implied

build_dag.name: coarse complete n600 vertical codec

build_dag.name: V9 geometry and topology refinement
build_dag.deliverable: lower-description all-class obligations and event grammar on the same object
build_dag.gate: n600 receiver-visible per-class debt and real byte cost improve as an atomic bundle

build_dag.name: V10 R10 prosody and feature-relay inverse
build_dag.deliverable: two-plane feature-relay/multiple-shooting solver with uint8 and tie closure
build_dag.gate: same-object n600 Seg/Pose/rate improves after exact decode

build_dag.name: conditional frame0 Pose and xi

build_dag.gate: official six-output Pose debt falls without hidden Seg or byte transfer

build_dag.name: native finite grammar and coder race
build_dag.deliverable: joint and split physical coder modes, headers, checksums, parse-back, and mutation proofs
build_dag.gate: every logical role is priced, while joint physical coding remains legal and globally recompressed

build_dag.name: factor10 atomic bundle compiler
build_dag.deliverable: costate-ranked, order-aware proposals and exact joint accept/rollback

build_dag.name: terminal quotient competition
build_dag.deliverable: matched-byte analytic basis, dictionary, and optional learned-T candidates
build_dag.gate: T is admitted only for measured unreachable debt and passes no-relearning, deletion, quantization, parse-back, and resumability controls

build_dag.name: authority branch
build_dag.deliverable: the exact same complete n600 archive evaluated separately on governed contest CPU and CUDA surfaces
build_dag.gate: may branch from any complete candidate; bank a custody-complete pointer break as a milestone and continue toward C8

build_dag.name: mission completion
build_dag.gate: strict mission threshold, not merely one pointer break

training_policy.compact_function_fit: training is allowed when it is the cheapest numerical method for fitting a declared compact typed function under scorer-and-coder-in-loop measurement; its variables, bytes, and resume state remain explicit
training_policy.extra_residual_T: only terminal, only for measured unreachable quotient debt, and never allowed to relearn V9 geometry, V10 realization, palette/gauge, or Pose transport
required_controls: resumable per-stage checkpoints with EMA and deterministic seeds
T-off byte-identical control when T exists
post-quantization parse-back and exact same-object score

autonomous_scheduler.unit_of_work: content-addressed state transition or atomic same-object bundle
autonomous_scheduler.priority: expected negative exact delta-S per wall-clock, conditioned on uncertainty, blocker depth, and information gain
autonomous_scheduler.feedback_loop: V9 proposal -> V10 Y0/Y1 realization and R10 feature relay -> real coder -> decode and score -> costate debt back to V9/V10 -> atomic accept or rollback
stop_conditions: same formulation sealed exhausted with a scoped negative
irreversible or paid action requires operator authority
autonomous_scheduler.non_stop_milestone: a first score below the refreshed competitive pointer is banked but does not end the campaign
